issues.on_page: Other local receipts 880,884 less 490,000 transfer = 390,884: Activities Fund 278,521 (p11) + General fees/rentals/licenses/refunds/other 26,184 (p6) + Employee Benefit Other Receipts 71,147 (p10) + Special Building 14,935 + Bond 65 + QCPU 32
issues.issue: [fixed 2026-10-28: category set to Extracurricular Receipts, review note updated] The extraction's own review note says 71% (278,521) is Activities Fund receipts. Under the rules (school activity fund receipts go to Extracurricular Receipts; when one category is more than half of a broad line, use it), the category should be Extracurricular Receipts, not charges for services/fees. The amount 390,884 itself is right.
